note: WAEC Agricultural Science round 5 (Round 25 top-up): rain gauge, hygrometer, sunshine recorder, anemometer, weather vs climate; mass extension method, agent duties, T&V fixed-day visits, ADP; ranging poles, prismatic compass, theodolite; alley cropping, taungya, resin as minor forest product; introduction, selection, hybridization; human power, mouldboard plough, daily greasing, harrow; silo vs crib, moisture spoilage, refrigeration; gill net action, cage culture, fish meal protein; rotational grazing, carrying capacity, Pearson square 20 kg, gross margin N100,000, marketing channel, post-harvest price fall, diversification. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Agric (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
